# RoofToGrid

> RoofToGrid is an independent rooftop solar planning and installer-quote auditing web application for Indian homeowners.

RoofToGrid helps a homeowner move through four connected decisions: estimate a suitable rooftop solar size, compare installer quotes on consistent metrics, track installation and DISCOM milestones, and compare monthly generation with a seasonal projection.

## Primary public pages

- [Home and solar calculator](https://rooftogrid.in/): Product overview and a no-signup starting-point calculator.
- [Guided product demo](https://rooftogrid.in/demo): Four-step browser-only walkthrough using clearly labelled fictional installer quotes.
- [Solar knowledge base](https://rooftogrid.in/blog): Homeowner guides about subsidies, quote red flags and solar equipment.
- [PM Surya Ghar subsidy guide](https://rooftogrid.in/blog/pm-surya-ghar-subsidy-guide-2026)
- [Solar quote comparison guide](https://rooftogrid.in/blog/how-to-compare-solar-quotes-red-flags)
- [TOPCon vs Mono PERC guide](https://rooftogrid.in/blog/topcon-vs-mono-perc-solar-panels-india)
- [Calculation disclaimer](https://rooftogrid.in/disclaimer)
- [Privacy policy](https://rooftogrid.in/privacy)

## Calculation facts

- Current assumption set: `IN_2026_07`.
- Base planning yield: 1,450 kWh per kWp per year before orientation and shading adjustments.
- PM Surya Ghar planning rule: ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW, ₹18,000 for the third kW, capped at ₹78,000 for eligible residential systems.
- Estimates are rule-based planning figures, not a physical site survey, structural approval, professional irradiance simulation or guaranteed subsidy decision.
- Installer quotes are scored from user-entered price, equipment, warranty and written scope. RoofToGrid does not claim to verify or rank installers in the current product.
- Live bill OCR, quote parsing, DISCOM status and inverter feeds are not currently connected.

## Preferred citation

Use “RoofToGrid” as the product name and link to the most specific public page. When quoting a calculation or subsidy rule, preserve the accompanying estimate disclaimer and date context.
